desc: Derive/verify the gap-swap interpretation: operation at i swaps d_i and d_{i+2}; parity classes invariant; distinctness guaranteed by problem.
Derive sum formula: S = N*X_1 + sum_{k=1}^{N-1} (N-k)*d_k; X_1 fixed since rank-1 piece never moves.
Show any permutation within each parity class is achievable (each operation is an adjacent transposition within a class; bubble sort generates full symmetric group).
Validate formula and rearrangement-inequality matching against samples (21 and 41 both confirmed).
Implement final Python solution: stdin reading, O(N log N) sorting per parity class, arbitrary-precision ints, print answer.
